text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At an interactive fan event aimed at 
families—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Alright everyone, it's bento time!♪

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
C-Curren-chan! Um, you see... about my 
rolled omelet...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, that looks so delicious! It's all 
shiny and fluffy~!

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! My mom's cooking is super 
delicious! So you can have some too, 
Curren-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, thanks~! ...Mama, Curren's gonna have 
one too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
So cu... huh!? Y-Yes!! Don't stop at just 
one, please have as many as you want!!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Boy
text_block_list.text:
! C-Cu... Curren-chan!! You can eat my 
whole lunch too!!

text_block_list.name: Precocious Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no fair, no faiiiir! I'll give 
Curren-chan my whole lunchbox too! My 
dad's rice balls are super yummy!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! All of it~? Everyone's so kind~. Can 
Curren finish it all, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still... hmm. That bento is packed with 
everyone's favorite side dishes, right? So 
for Curren to eat it all would be—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: ALRIGHT!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...W-Wah~! Really~? We should ask 
everyone's moms and dads too...

text_block_list.name: Parents
text_block_list.text: Yes, please!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh-ho?
choice_data_list: Can I eat with you, too?
Can I eat with you, too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh-ho?
choice_data_list: Can I eat with you, too?
Can I eat with you, too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ! Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, everyone. Big Brother says he's 
hungry too! Can Curren share her portion 
with him?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, everyone. Big Sister says she's 
hungry too! Can Curren share her portion 
with her?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Sure thing!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah! Thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to you too, Onii-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to you too, Big Sis♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the bento gathering with the fans 
came to a safe and enjoyable conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey☆ I'm gonna drink in every 
single bit of everyone's love♪

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Wah! I'll give you this too! And this, and 
this too--!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, thank you~♪ All this love makes 
Curren so happy!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Feed Curren a bite of your 
lunch♪ And we'll have Papa and Mama take a 
picture☆

text_block_list.name: Parents
text_block_list.text: Hawa, hawawawawa! Curren Chan is so cute!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, the participants posted their 
photos on social media all at once, 
sending the hashtag "#CurrenChanMeetup" 
straight to the #1 trending spot...!
